description: Defines the TlsHandshaker class for managing TLS handshake in QUIC, including methods for processing input, managing secrets, and handling connection states.

classes.name: TlsHandshaker
classes.description: Base class for managing TLS handshake in QUIC, providing common functionality for client and server handshakers.

classes.name: ProofVerifierCallbackImpl
classes.description: Handles asynchronous certificate verification callback within TlsHandshaker.

methods.name: ProcessInput
methods.description: Processes input data for TLS handshake.

methods.name: BufferSizeLimitForLevel
methods.description: Gets buffer size limit for a given encryption level.

methods.name: AdvanceKeysAndCreateCurrentOneRttDecrypter
methods.description: Advances keys and creates current 1-RTT decrypter.

methods.name: ExportKeyingMaterialForLabel
methods.description: Exports keying material for a given label and context.

methods.name: AdvanceHandshake
methods.description: Called when a new handshake message is available.

methods.name: CloseConnection
methods.description: Closes connection with error and reason.

methods.name: ShouldCloseConnectionOnUnexpectedError
methods.description: Determines if connection should close on SSL error.

methods.name: Prf
methods.description: Returns the PRF for negotiated cipher.

methods.name: SetWriteSecret
methods.description: Sets write secret for encryption level.

methods.name: SetReadSecret
methods.description: Sets read secret for decryption level.

methods.name: WriteMessage
methods.description: Writes TLS message to QUIC stream.

methods.name: SendAlert
methods.description: Sends TLS alert and closes connection if needed.
